test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 13 Feb 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A boat can travel at a speed of 10 km/h in still water. If the speed of the stream is 2 km/h, find the time taken by the boat to go 72 km downstream.
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of the boat in still water: 10 km/h

Speed of the stream: 2 km/h

Distance to travel downstream: 72 km

**Concept:**

The effective speed of the boat downstream is the sum of the boat's speed in still water and the speed of the stream.

**Calculation:**

⇒ Speed of the boat downstream = 10 km/h + 2 km/h = 12 km/h

⇒ Time = Distance/Speed

⇒ Time = 72 km/12 km/h = 6 hours.

**Therefore, the boat will take 6 hours to travel 72 km downstream.**
